descriptions.en: Command Code Provider API chat with Host-only model discovery, credential storage, and best-effort subscription usage reporting.
descriptions.zh: Command Code Provider API 聊天，模型发现和凭据存储均由 Host 持有，并提供 best-effort 订阅用量展示。

notice.en: Chat uses the documented Provider API; optional quota reporting also reads unofficial account routes used by the official CLI.
notice.zh: 聊天使用文档化 Provider API；可选额度展示还会读取官方 CLI 使用的非公开账户接口。
